newsitem.title: USA: WESTSPHERE INVESTS IN 4 SOUTH AMERICAN COMPANIES.
newsitem.headline: WESTSPHERE INVESTS IN 4 SOUTH AMERICAN COMPANIES.

text.p: WestSphere Equity Investors LP said its South America Private Equity Growth Fund LP invested in four South American companies.

Westsphere said it invested $20.4 million in Quimica Estrella SA, an Argentine manufacturer of consumer goods, $9.8 million in Marquie SA and Vaplas SA, Argentine manufacturers of plastic film and flexible plastic packaging, and $14.8 million in Tramaca Holding SA, a ground transportation company in Chile.

WestSphere Capital Associates LP, a private New York-based equity investment firm, formed WestSphere Equity to manage the South America Fund which invests in South American middle-market companies with ties to the U.S. business community.
